ValidationRule.description: Restricting Selection of Users' based on the Attendee Subtype for RBM, EM values
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(AttendeeType,'Internal'), Interaction.RecordType.DeveloperName = "RBM_Broker_Interaction", OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( Attendee_SubType__c ,'EM'), NOT(User.UserRole.Name = 'Enablement Manager') ), AND( ISPICKVAL( Attendee_SubType__c ,'RBM'), Not(User.UserRole.Name = 'Residential Broker Manager') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please Select the Appropriate User according to the Attendee Subtype Selected.
